## OpenCode Agent Response Time v0.1.0

Hover the duration at the bottom of an agent response in OpenCode Desktop to see the exact completion time of that turn.

### Highlights

- Hover tooltip on completed agent response durations
- Exact turn completion timestamp read from the current session's synced messages
- Native compact tooltip styling, light/dark themes and locale-aware formatting
- npm installation, preview image and CI workflow

### Install

```jsonc
"plugins": [
  "@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-show-agent-response-time@0.1.0"
]
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@devdengchao/opencode-plugin-show-agent-response-time
